title: What too little sleep does
description:
How losing sleep night after night affects focus, hunger, immunity and mood.
#sleep #health #science #focus
AI-free animation made with code. Not medical advice.

music.credit: Music: "Cut and Run" - Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0

lines.hook: What happens if you only sleep four hours?
lines.b1: After one night of just four hours, your focus and reaction time drop.
lines.b2: By the third short night, hunger hormones rise, and cravings grow stronger.
lines.b3: After a week like this, your immune system weakens too.
lines.b4: After two full weeks, mood drops, and small things feel much harder.
lines.end: How many hours did you sleep last night?
